Friesecke2019 and EmamiPass2024 give non-Monge examples, not an all-N bounded scalar signed-contrast family with exact 1/N loss.
GaoGeQian2025 solves the fractional causal MOT problem; no checked source gives this same-empirical-marginal realizability-gap frontier.
AronowGreenLee2014: sharp two-arm covariance/variance bounds are attained by quantile extremal couplings.
GaoGeQian2025 gives fractional MOT endpoints and BrennanEtAl2025 gives numerical integer-program completions, neither the proposed universal same-N analytic certificate.

soundness_flags.label: prop:two-arm-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed two-arm randomization-variance reduction has no declared two-arm assignment law, arm counts, estimator, or endpoint functional, while the sole complete-randomization assumption is explicitly three-arm.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper formulates causal partial identification as K-marginal MOT, obtains the fractional identified set, and proves plug-in convergence/minimax results for its fractional MOT target.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2401.12417, public preprint corresponding to the cited 2025 journal article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: It gives a three-marginal, three-support-point, two-dimensional quadratic non-Monge example, proves Monge existence for two-point empirical marginals, and names rigorous quantification of Monge-ansatz error as future work.
Algorithm 3 performs Sinkhorn scaling and rounds an approximately feasible tensor back into the fractional transportation polytope; it does not output an equal-weight N-row Monge schedule.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1405.6555, matching the cited Annals of Statistics article DOI 10.1214/13-AOS1200
source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3, Lemma 1; equations (7)-(11); Appendix A proof of Lemma 1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives sharp two-arm variance bounds through comonotone and countermonotone quantile couplings and plug-in estimation under complete randomization.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1407.6475, corresponding to Operations Research Letters 43(1) (2015)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies complete mixability and multidimensional bottleneck assignment, proving NP-completeness in general and fixed-column approximation results for bottleneck row sums.

The paper uses an integer program to compute numerical worst-case copulas for generalized causal-bootstrap settings and proves asymptotic validity; it does not state a universal analytic same-N realization-width rate.
The article treats randomization-based finite-population causal inference, with fixed potential outcomes and treatment assignment as the source of randomness, including multiple treatment levels.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract; Theorem 1.1; joint-mixability and open-questions discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article presents rearrangement representations and surveys unresolved multivariate extremal-dependence and joint-mixability geometry.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:1808.04318, corresponding to SIAM Journal on Mathematical Analysis 51(6) (2019)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work analyzes non-Monge extreme points of a finite three-marginal Kantorovich polytope but does not give the proposed scalar same-marginal all-N rate frontier.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: State a self-contained two-arm submodel: arm set, fixed counts, assignment law, contrast estimator, and the two endpoint functionals, then prove the displayed reduction to Aronow-Green-Lee rather than referring to unspecified resulting endpoints.

Add a compact exact worked instance of the rounding algorithm, including its fractional table, dual-tight support, repaired permutations, and realized primal-dual width; this would make the claimed constructive mechanism independently auditable.

Sharpen the field contribution by deriving a materially smaller universal constant or a structural zero-gap criterion for a nontrivial class of three-arm marginals, with an explicit comparison to the integer-program comparator.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two-arm sanity proposition into a fully declared two-arm finite-population statement, then advance this field-grade same-N rounding frontier to Stage 0.
